comment: R2-P2-04: explicit-review allowlist for OpenAPI schema drift.
An entry allows schema differences under 'path_prefix' ONLY until 'expires'.
Expired entries fail the contract test; empty entries = exact schema match.
Fields: path_prefix (dot-path prefix in the OpenAPI document), reason,
approved_by (a person, not a role), approved_at (YYYY-MM-DD),
